bio.text: Derek Wulf is a Republican state representative for Iowa House District 76 and has served in the Iowa House since 2023.

The Iowa Legislature's 2023 biography lists Wulf as a farmer and rancher and former swine nutrition and production specialist at Cargill, with a bachelor's degree from Iowa State University, born in 1981 in rural Black Hawk County and raised and living in Hudson.
In June 2026, Republican gubernatorial candidate Zach Lahn's campaign announced Wulf as the running mate; Wulf was nominated for lieutenant governor at the Republican State Convention.
